content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for OAV Rajapur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://ganjam.odisha.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 03-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for OAV Rajapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications for OAV Rajapur Recruitment 2026 is 03 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by OAV Rajapur?
faq.answer: Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Rajapur has released a total of 5 vacancies for various posts, including Warden, Chowkidar-cum-sweeper, Head Cook, and Assistant Cook.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for OAV Rajapur Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and submit it via post or as instructed in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Warden post?
faq.answer: For the Warden post, candidates must possess a BA/B.Sc degree. Other posts have different qualification requirements as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for OAV Rajapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates applying for OAV Rajapur Recruitment 2026. Both General/OBC and SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The salary structure varies for different posts. The Warden post offers a salary of Rs. 21175 per month, while other posts like Chowkidar-cum-sweeper, Head Cook, and Assistant Cook have salaries ranging from Rs. 6750 to Rs. 9000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for the posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for OAV Rajapur Recruitment 2026 will be based on Career Marking percentage, percentage of marks in Matric/HSC, and a subsequent interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Ganjam District, which is https://ganjam.odisha.gov.in. The direct link is also provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q9. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The specific age limit details for each post are not explicitly mentioned in the summary. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for precise age criteria and any applicable age relaxations.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates along with the filled application form.
